scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix game install && npm --prefix admin install && npm run db:local && npm --prefix game run assets
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,game,admin -c yellow,green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix game run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix game run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.build:staging: npm --prefix game run build:staging && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.build:ci: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix game ci && npm --prefix admin ci && npm run build
scripts.deploy:api: npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy -c server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:api:staging: npm run db:remote:staging && wrangler deploy -c server/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:game: npm --prefix game run build && wrangler deploy -c game/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:game:staging: npm --prefix game run build:staging && wrangler deploy -c game/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:admin: npm --prefix admin run build && wrangler deploy -c admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply tower-rush --local -c server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply tower-rush --remote -c server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:remote:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tower-rush-staging --remote -c server/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && cd game && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../admin && npx tsc --noEmit
